test_simple_redistribution: test the SimpleRedistribution redistribution model with all combinations of evolving ion heat, electron heat, and density profiles
build_redistribution_model: build a SimpleRedistribution model from a ToraxConfig with sawtooth trigger and redistribution settings
build_runtime_params_provider: build a RuntimeParamsProvider from a ToraxConfig to supply runtime parameters at a given time
initial_core_profiles: initialize core plasma profiles from runtime parameters, geometry, source models, and neoclassical models
calc_q_face: calculate the q-face profile from normalized flux values and geometry to verify redistribution effects
